abstract: Increasingly, treatment choices leading to the same survival outcome can be offered to cancer patients (e.g. mastectomy or conservative surgery in early breast cancer). Two approaches available for post-orchidectomy, stage I patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis (NSGCTT), particularly those at high risk of relapse, include immediate adjuvant chemotherapy (two courses) or surveillance, with chemotherapy (typically four courses) given only on relapse. The aim of this study was to investigate which approach patients prefer. Questionnaires were given to newly diagnosed NSGCTT patients, to patients with previous experience of the two options and to non-cancer controls, including specialist testicular tumour oncologists. Participants were asked to choose between immediate chemotherapy, surveillance or for the doctor to decide, at recurrence risk levels ranging from 10% to 90%. Questionnaires were returned by 207 subjects in nine different groups. The risk thresholds at which subjects' management preference changed, within apparently homogeneous groups, varied greatly, although at least one subject in each group selected adjuvant chemotherapy at the lowest (10%) level of risk. Subjects tended to favour options of which they had previous experience. Cancer patients wanted the doctor to decide more frequently than controls. The wide variability observed makes it difficult to predict which option an individual will select. Personality factors and personal circumstances, other than specific experience and knowledge, are obviously influential. Many patients would prefer their doctor to decide, but variability among oncologists is as great as that among their patients.
abstract_ja: がんの治療では、同じ生存成績をもたらす選択肢を提示できる場合がある（例：早期乳がんにおける乳房切除術または乳房温存手術）。精巣摘除術後の病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者、特に再発リスクが高い患者に対しては、直ちに補助化学療法（2コース）を行う方法と、経過観察を行い再発時のみ化学療法（通常4コース）を行う方法の2つがある。本研究の目的は、患者がどちらの方法を選好するかを調べることであった。新規診断の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者、両方の選択肢を経験した患者、およびがん以外の対照者（腫瘍専門医を含む）を対象に質問紙を配布した。対象者は、直ちに化学療法、経過観察、または医師に決めてもらうことのいずれかを、10%から90%までの再発リスクの各水準で選択するよう求められた。9群の207名から回答が得られた。各群内で選好が変化するリスク閾値は大きく異なったが、各群で少なくとも1名は最も低いリスク（10%）で補助化学療法を選んだ。対象者は、過去に経験した選択肢を好む傾向があった。がん患者は対照者より医師に決めてもらうことを望む割合が高かった。この大きなばらつきから、個人がどの選択肢を選ぶかを予測することは難しい。個人の状況や性格要因は、特定の経験や知識以外にも明らかに影響する。多くの患者は医師に決めてもらうことを望むが、腫瘍専門医間のばらつきも患者間と同程度に大きい。
